environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAF WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with default action, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet with default action, (3) A custom rule with priority 3 that inspects query string parameters using a regex pattern matching statement with the pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+(?:all\s+)?select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d)` set to BLOCK. Additionally, the WebACL has a rate-based rule limiting to 300 requests per 5-minute window per source IP. The ECS task role has no network egress except to the ALB and CloudWatch Logs (VPC endpoints only, no NAT gateway, no internet gateway on the task subnet). The container runs as a non-root user (uid 1000) with a read-only root filesystem except /var/lib/app and /tmp.
